products.name: Cooler Master MasterFrame 700 Full Tower Open-Air Frame Gaming Casing
products.description:
Cooler Master MasterFrame 700 Full Tower Open-Air Frame Gaming Casing

The Cooler Master MasterFrame 700 Full Tower Casing is a highly configurable open-air frame that may be used as a display PC chassis or a very versatile test bench. The MasterFrame 700 is made up of three parts: two side wings and a fully functional motherboard tray. Four specifically engineered friction hinges secure the side wings to the motherboard tray, providing complete ranges of mobility during installation as well as stability once assembled, ideal for bespoke water-cooling loops.

Open Air Design

The open-air design ensures that all system components have unfettered access to fresh air. Optional fan mounts control the airflow channel to a specified intake/exhaust direction, minimizing performance-detrimental heat recirculation. The MasterFrame 700 is positioned vertically to highlight the components hidden behind its panoramic tempered glass panel. The chassis provides unrivaled hardware compatibility, allowing for the simple installation of bigger components.

Motherboard, PSU Support & Storage Support

The Cooler Master MasterFrame 700 allows you to install any consumer-market motherboard, including 14x14" SSI-EEB motherboards. On the back, there is dual ATX power supply compatibility for systems that require a dual power supply to fulfill all needs during hard overclocking sessions. The MasterFrame 700 has a unique, entirely toolless mechanism for mounting up to four 3.5" disks and seven 2.5" drives. Up to two 280/360mm radiators may be mounted in "Open-Air" mode on the two side wings, and a third radiator up to 360/420mm can be mounted in "Test-Bench" mode. Because of the support for pumps and reservoirs, most solutions on the market can be mounted natively, allowing for a high degree of placement flexibility.

Cooling Support

Users of the MasterFrame 700 can add up to two 280/360mm radiators in "Open-Air" mode (on the two side wings) and a third 360/420mm radiator in "Test-Bench" mode, next to the CPU socket. The support for pumps and reservoirs on the right side of the motherboard tray enables natively mounting of most solutions on the market while preserving a high level of placement flexibility.

Un-Matched Hardware Support & Test Bench Mode

The MasterFrame 700 has an unrivaled amount of hardware compatibility for its size. It is intended to accommodate any available component, including big ones. Users may install up to three SSI-EEB motherboards, multiple power supplies, and numerous radiators while still having the capacity for triple slots GPUs and storage. The side wings may fold down towards the CPU socket and GPU sections, allowing airflow to be localized to the components, which is very advantageous during overclocking. The wings also serve as storage for triple-fan radiators and other accessories, and replacing components while maintaining the cooling solution in place is now easier than ever.

Premium Variable Friction Hinges

Heavy sturdy hinges secure the side wings to the mid-frame and allow for seamless shifting at any angle to meet the demands of the user. Allen keys are available to change the tension of the hinges to facilitate moving or holding heavy items easier. This kind of adaptability is critical for customers who want to create incredibly unique water-cooling loops and installations.

Panoramic Tempered Glass

The enlarged panoramic tempered glass provides a wider viewing angle on the system's components and when combined with the hardware-centric design of the MasterFrame 700, is the ideal method to display high-end components and specialized cooling solutions.

Vesa Mount Compatible & Designed for Customization

The MasterFrame 700 is wall-mountable thanks to its 100mm x 100mm VESA mount capability. Ideal for displaying bespoke loops and high-end components. It is strongly advised to only wall mount entire systems weighing less than 14Kg in total and to verify VESA weight guidelines. It was created with customization in mind. The three-part frame can readily be dismantled for painting, wrapping, and other alterations. The Cooler Master MasterFrame 700 Full Tower Casing has no warranty.
